newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet stumbles with gas oil futures, demand thin.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet stumbles with gas oil futures, demand thin.

text.p: NWE jet fuel fell on Wednesday, knocked lower by easier IPE gas oil futures.
March IPE closed $1.75 a tonne lower at $162.00 but had seen as high as $167 in morning trade.
Premiums were broadly unchanged, but physical activity was very thin, traders said.
"No one is in a hurry to buy, its pretty flat," said one.
Barge premiums were assessed around March IPE gas oil +$20-21 fob ARA with cargoes a few dollars firmer for cif.
"Cargoes are even more thinly talked than barges," said a dealer.
